headline: Record profitability as digital growth engines accelerate
summary_short: News Corp's fiscal Q4 revenue rose to $2.34B (+11% y/y) and net income from continuing operations more than doubled to $230M, with Total Segment EBITDA up 31% to $423M on strength across Dow Jones, Digital Real Estate Services, and Book Publishing.
summary_long: Revenue growth was broad-based: Dow Jones +7% on digital subscriptions and Risk & Compliance; Digital Real Estate Services +19% (REA Group +21%, Move +13%); Book Publishing +15% on frontlist/backlist strength; News Media +5%, mostly FX. Segment EBITDA rose 31% to $423M as revenue gains outpaced costs. Net income from continuing operations rose 167% to $230M on higher EBITDA and lower impairment/restructuring charges. Full-year free cash flow rose 42% to $811M, funding a $643M buyback (>4x prior year) and a $0.10/share dividend. Cash fell to $2.10B q/q as buybacks accelerated. No numeric forward guidance was issued.
